::: {#def-cond-gaussian}
#### Conditional Gaussian model

A **conditional Gaussian model** for outcomes $\dsn{Y}$
with covariate values $\dsn{x}$
(each a single value or a vector)
says that, given the covariates,
the outcomes are independent and Gaussian:
outcome $\Outvar_\iobs$ is centered on a mean function $\mean(x)$
evaluated at $x_i$,
and has its own variance $\varpar_i$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Outvar_\iobs \mid X_i = x_i &\simind \ndist{\mean_i, \varpar_i},\\
\mean_i &\eqdef \mean(x_i).
\end{aligned}
$$
:::
